featured_reviews.review_text: I had a requirement earlier in 2010 for white blood platelets where I approached a blood bank in Vasai and they gave me 4 packets of white blood platelets for ₹4000 and they had informed me to come back after the emergency with 4 donors and they will refund half the amount that is ₹2000 which I did and got the refund amount. However, just 2 days ago I approached Sathya Trust Blood Center and bought white blood platelets for a family member for ₹3600. I went back today  to check if I could donate blood and get a refund of some amount or even show my blood donation certificates to check if I could get a refund but they denied it. They stated they only have the refund offer on purchase of red blood. As a feedback, we think you should have a blood donation refund amount to some extent for purchase of white blood platelets also. It will really help the people who are financially weak and it would make a lot of difference to them.
